title: Knowledge Notes
noRootDesc: Choose a local folder as the vault for your knowledge notes. Everything is stored as plain Markdown files in that folder, so you can open it with Obsidian or any other tool anytime.
aiSettingsDesc: Knowledge Notes reuses model services you already added under Settings → Models to distill chats and documents — no need to enter a URL or key again.
aiFollowDefault: Follow default (auto-use the app's configured model)
aiDefaultModelHint: Follow default: automatically use the first usable model among your configured model services.
aiPickModelPlaceholder: Choose a model of this service
aiPickProviderFirst: Please choose a model service first
aiNoProviderDesc: You have not added any model service yet. The AI features of Knowledge Notes reuse the models you add under Settings → Models. Please go to Settings and add/enable one first.
aiGoSettings: Go to Settings to add a model
aiSettingsNote: Keys and URLs are maintained in Settings → Models only; only the model choice is saved here.
aiModelNeededToKb: Go to Knowledge Notes and choose a model
aiCardNoProviderOnThisPage: No usable model service yet. Add and enable a model in the Model services section below, then come back here to pick one for Knowledge Notes.
emptyNotes: No notes yet. Create a note, save a chat session, or import a document.
